note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a ERI 4; A06b ERI 4; L05 ERI 8(1)(a), 8(1)(c)): ordinary naturalisation after 20 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another. Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Eritrea, 2024
sources.said: Person is not of 'Eritrean origin' and has been legally resident in Eritrea for at least 10 years before 1974 or at least 20 years while making visits abroad. ... Renunciation of citizenship of another country required. ... Person voluntarily acquires another citizenship or signs an oath of allegiance to another country after publication of the 1992 Proclamation (=nationality law).
